_note: Blank Finn state — a clean starting point. Schema + methodology kept; no inherited content. Set your config in `portfolio`, then run `gmf`. See FINN_SETUP.md.

_meta.read_first: Load at the start of every session (GMF). All portfolio data lives here. The system prompt is the brain; this is the state.
_meta.edit_rule: One canonical state file. Update it the same response any decision is made. Re-upload to the Project after changes.

dev_pack._note: OPTIONAL. Add to the Project only to build/extend Finn. Runtime works without them.

portfolio._set_these: Replace placeholders, then clear this note.

scores.system_note: Dual rating: CS (Conviction, 1-100) + MS (Momentum/Setup, 1-100). Live CS/MS per owned name live on each `positions` entry; snapshots archived in history[].

reviews.trigger_rules: WIN +40% / LOSS -20% / any full exit. Open reviews carry as TODO.

canonical_tiers_named._note: Rename/repopulate these buckets for your own universe.

macro.scaffolding_note: The engine scans adjacents + read-through + smart-money each session, materiality-scores for the book, and diffs vs last_scan.

risk.notes: Trim any single name back under the ceiling % of NAV.

catalysts.auto_fire_rules: A scenario page fires automatically when ANY is true: (a) an owned name has earnings <7 days, (b) a major catalyst on an owned name, (c) a price target is breached, (d) a live decision fork.
